purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Jeonju City’s official Living Geographic Information site is a public municipal map and its map page identifies a cadastral-map (`지적도`) layer. The city’s official page also links national cadastral/LX and land-planning services. No current public full-polygon schema or safe WUP-point feature response was verified.
